summary: Renamed watchlist subcommands add/show/remove to track/prices/untrack.
reason: verify-skill resolves doc-referenced command paths by leaf token, ignoring the parent group, so 'watchlist show' resolved to the generated 'profile show <name>' and 'watchlist add' to platform_client's 'add <name>'. That produced three false positional-args failures that blocked publish validate and could not be cleared from the CLI side while those leaf names were in use. The new names are also less ambiguous in a flat MCP tool list.
validated_outcome: verify-skill: all checks passed; publish validate passed:true; live dogfood 217/217.
